status: G5 first batch: processed, compressed and reviewed; ships as g5-siege-ramp, in Chapter V
use: Chapter V's Persian siege ramp (the field object 'siege-engine') on its cell while it is worked; disabled, its code-built burnt planks remain.

generator.prompt: A section of a Persian siege ramp of the third century: a sloping mound of packed earth and rubble held in by a revetment of horizontal timber beams and woven reed hurdles, rising from the ground to about one and a half metres over two and a half metres of length, with a tall woven wicker screen standing at its upper end. Earth, rubble, weathered timber and reed. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
